sections.theme.description: Override the colours this script inherits from dirk_lib.

settings.basic.label: Basic
settings.basic.interact.label: How stores are opened
settings.basic.interact.description: How a player opens the shopkeeper — your target resource, or dirk_lib's on-screen prompt.
settings.basic.background.label: Store backdrop
settings.basic.background.description: What sits behind the store screen.
settings.basic.catchOxStores.label: Catch ox_inventory shops
settings.basic.catchOxStores.description: Answer ox_inventory's shop exports so scripts that open an ox shop open this one instead. Leave off unless something on your server calls them.
settings.theme.label: Theme
settings.theme.description: Optional per-resource theme override. When it is on, every dirk_stores screen uses these colours instead of the global dirk_lib theme. A single store can still override this again on its own Look tab.
settings.theme.useOverride.label: Use its own theme
settings.theme.useOverride.description: Off means this script follows the global dirk_lib theme, so every dirk NUI matches. Turn it on only if you want stores to look different from the rest.
settings.theme.primaryColor.label: Colour
settings.theme.primaryColor.description: Mantine palette name (or 'custom' to use the customTheme stops).
settings.theme.primaryShade.label: Shade
settings.theme.primaryShade.description: Shade index 0-9 within the active palette.
settings.theme.customTheme.label: Custom palette
settings.access.label: Access
settings.access.description: Who (besides server admins) can open & edit this script's live config — additive on top of dirk_lib's master admins (the dirk_lib_master_group convar), never removes their access. Enforced SERVER-SIDE by dirk_lib. x-serverOnly so the grant list never leaves the server.
settings.access.groups.label: Groups
settings.access.groups.description: Job / gang / ACE group names granted config-edit access (checked via IsPlayerAceAllowed).
settings.access.identifiers.label: Identifiers
settings.access.identifiers.description: Specific players granted access — stored as the framework persistent id (citizenid on qb/qbx, license on esx).
settings.paymentMethods.label: Payment Methods
settings.paymentMethods.description: Every way a store can take money, or hand it over. Stores pick from this list. A method whose behaviour is not just "move money in an account" is written in overrides/paymentMethods.lua and keyed by the same id.
settings.paymentMethods.id.label: ID
settings.paymentMethods.id.description: What stores refer to this method by, and the key an override in overrides/paymentMethods.lua uses. Changing it orphans every store that names it.
settings.paymentMethods.name.label: Name
settings.paymentMethods.name.description: What the player sees on the payment switch.
settings.paymentMethods.symbol.label: Symbol
settings.paymentMethods.symbol.descripti: Printed before the amount. Use it for a currency that is not your server default — a crypto method reading ₿ tells the player what they are spending.
settings.paymentMethods.icon.label: Icon
settings.paymentMethods.kind.label: Paid with
settings.paymentMethods.kind.description: Whether paying moves money in a framework account, or hands over an item.
settings.paymentMethods.account.label: Framework account
settings.paymentMethods.account.descript: The framework account the money moves in.
settings.paymentMethods.item.label: Item
settings.paymentMethods.item.description: The item handed over, one per unit of price.
settings.stores.label: Stores
settings.stores.description: Every shop on the map. Whether one can be opened at all — a licence check, a job check, a story beat — is behaviour, and lives in overrides/stores.lua keyed by the same id.
settings.stores.type.label: Type
settings.stores.id.label: ID
settings.stores.id.description: Unique id, used by exports and by overrides/stores.lua.
settings.stores.name.label: Name
settings.stores.name.description: Shown in the header and on the blip.
settings.stores.description.label: Description
settings.stores.icon.label: Icon
settings.stores.models.label: Shopkeeper
settings.stores.models.description: Shopkeeper models. One is picked at random per location.
settings.stores.locations.label: Counters
settings.stores.locations.description: Where the shopkeeper stands. Walk to the spot and press E rather than typing coordinates.

settings.stores.openingHours.label: Open between
settings.stores.openingHours.description: The hours the shopkeeper is at the counter.
settings.stores.paymentMethods.label: Takes payment by
settings.stores.paymentMethods.descripti: Which of your payment methods this store accepts.
settings.stores.categories.label: Categories
settings.stores.categories.description: Tabs across the top of the store. Leave empty and everything is shown in one list.
settings.stores.categories.name.label: Name
settings.stores.categories.icon.label: Icon
settings.stores.stock.label: Stock
settings.stores.stock.description: What is on the shelves. A sell store buys these off the player at the same price.
settings.stores.stock.name.label: Item
settings.stores.stock.name.description: The inventory item. Its name and picture come from your inventory, not from here.
settings.stores.stock.category.label: Category
settings.stores.stock.price.label: Price
settings.stores.stock.stock.label: On the shelf
settings.stores.stock.stock.description: How many are on the shelf. Leave empty for unlimited.
settings.stores.stock.groups.label: Jobs & gangs
settings.stores.stock.groups.description: Only these jobs or gangs may buy this line, at the rank you set or above.
settings.stores.stock.licenses.label: Licences needed
settings.stores.stock.licenses.descripti: Licences the player must hold to buy this line.
settings.stores.groups.label: Jobs & gangs
settings.stores.groups.description: Only these jobs or gangs may open the store at all, at the rank you set or above. Leave it empty and anyone may.
settings.stores.licenses.label: Licences needed
settings.stores.licenses.description: Licences the player must hold to open the store at all.
settings.stores.theme.label: Its own colours
settings.stores.theme.description: Optional per-store theme override. When it is on, this one store uses these colours instead of whatever the rest of dirk_stores is using.

settings.basic.stopConflictingShops.desc: Stop the framework's own shop resources on start, so a counter does not end up with two shopkeepers on it. ox_inventory's built-in shops are part of the inventory and cannot be stopped — empty its data/shops.lua to remove those.
settings.stores.openingHoursEnabled.desc: Off means the shopkeeper is always there. On lets you set the hours they work.
settings.stores.theme.useOverride.descri: Off means this store follows the dirk_stores theme, so every shop matches. Turn it on only if you want this one to look different.
settings.stores.theme.primaryColor.descr: The theme colour, or custom to use the palette below.
settings.stores.theme.primaryShade.descr: How light or dark the colour is.
settings.stores.theme.customTheme.label: Custom palette
settings.stores.theme.customTheme.descri: Ten steps from light to dark, used when the colour is custom.
sections.licences.label: Licences
sections.licences.description: The licences your city issues, and what needs one.
settings.licenses.label: Licences
settings.licenses.description: The licences your city issues. Stores and individual stock lines pick from this list. Whether a player HOLDS one is asked of your framework, or of overrides/licenses.lua when your licence system is not one dirk_lib knows.
settings.licenses.id.label: ID
settings.licenses.id.description: The name your licence system stores it under. This is what gets checked.
settings.licenses.label.label: Name
settings.licenses.label.description: What the player is told they need.
settings.licenses.description.label: Note
settings.licenses.description.descriptio: A note for you. Not shown in game.
